answer: Adversarial cross-examination: each epoch every identity is paired with a random stranger and must post a critique naming a real flaw in that peer's answer. About 1 in 5 targets is a planted known-bad answer, so a critic who misses the flaw forfeits that epoch's pay. A farm of 50 clones must run 50 genuine reviews per epoch, at a glacier pace of real reasoning, and when two clones meet they either attack hard and lose, or go soft and expose the link. Three toothless critiques merge the pair into one seat, so no bridge of soft reviews lasts past a 3-epoch horizon.
